title_sq: SHITET DYQAN BASHKE ME GARSONIERE TEK FORTUZI
description_sq:
*NE CERTIFIKATE CILESUAR APARTAMENT*
Shitet apartament ne katin 0, buze rruge, funksional si ambient komercial, bashke me nje garsoniere po ne te njejtin kat me hyrje te vecuar.
Me nje siperfaqe 86m2, shfrytezohet ne dy njesi te ndryshme.
Dyqani eshte i rinovuar dhe momentalisht i lene me qera me nje vlere prej 500 euro, kurse garsonierja me nje vlere 250 euro. 
Per me shume informacion, kontaktoni.
title_en: COMBINED STORE WITH STUDIO APARTMENT FOR SALE IN FORTUZI
description_en: *APARTMENT QUALITY CERTIFICATE* Apartment for sale on the 0th floor, street corner, functional as a commercial environment, together with a studio on the same floor with a separate entrance. With an area of ​​86m2, it is used in two different units. The shop has been renovated and is currently being rented for 500 euros, while the studio apartment is for 250 euros.
